decision: cisco, 2026-08-10: we may correct other people's editions where we are SURE they are wrong. This apply completes that pass: the sheet applied on 2026-08-10 was generated from the artifact's 400-row decided sample by an uncommitted one-off, and these are the eligible forms the sample window missed.
rule: share >= 0.99 of a skeleton class holding >= 100 clean non-OCR tokens, and accent-only. Our own OCR went at >= 0.95; this is an order of magnitude stricter in expected error, because a wrong correction here is our error inside someone else's edition.
marks_moved: breathings, iota subscript and diaeresis are byte-identical between every form and its target; only accents moved
